name: Coca-Cola ICE Freezer [B42]
description: Choose from ten Coca-Cola ICE freezer percentages: 1%, 5%, 10%, 15%, 25%, 35%, 50%, 75%, 90%, 100%. Includes custom inventory icons and the original ICE pixel fix. Compatible with Nick's Turn Off Fridges. Three visual fill stages, with and without power. Storage capacity is unchanged.
